verdict.rationale: Spline documents two AI Agents that generate designs from natural-language prompts: the 3D AI Agent creates objects, materials, lighting, animation and interactivity from a description, and Hana's AI Agent designs full 2D screens (layout, type, colour, effects, states) from a text description, which can then be edited by hand. This directly matches the story of generating first drafts/mockups from a prompt. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the AI Agent's actual output quality, and no third-party reviews or demos confirming real-world reliability of these AI generation features.
